Miami garlic prawns.d: Seared with garlic, chili flakes, white wine and butter. Bread for the juices.
Miami garlic prawns.note: A taste of the Florida trip.

Fried mozzarella.d: Cheese fingers crumbed twice and fried golden, warm tomato sauce to dip.

Shoes-on teriyaki steak.d: Seared hot, glazed with soy, mirin and sake. Steamed rice, bok choy.
Shoes-on teriyaki steak.note: Tatami room. Shoes off, please. The boots stay on.

Ricotta cheesecake.d: Baked slow with lemon zest and vanilla, cooled in the oven.
Ricotta cheesecake.note: A quiet sweet finish for Lefty.

Social club Rob Roy.d: Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters over one big cube, orange peel, a cherry.
Social club Rob Roy.note: What the regulars from the club drink.
